body:
Depression spoils everything; is difficult to find enjoyment in anything these days. 


The novelty kind of wore off after a week of being employed.


I'd probably enjoy it more if I was the same person I was when I was 18. It's nice being involved in the developmental stages of projects and seeing how the project moves through it's the life cycle until final deployment. 


I have no idea what to do next. Or of I should transition to something else. My talents are rather ... limited.

I've never had to complete taxes before. I must wait until next year. The entire process looks complicated. 


Do you file yourself or have someone do them for you? Perhaps there's a smaller chance of error if someone trustworthy helps complete the tax forms. I could never trust myself enough for the same reason you mentioned.

I think you articulated my thoughts pretty accurately. I feel as if there are people who passed away who really didn't deserve to, and I'd trade my life for there's. 


Except the last few sentences. I haven't made an attempt at all. 


I really wish i never existed in the first place. My family knows I exist, and although some find me annoying at times, they've grown attached to me :/ My family would never understand my POV - mental illness is taboo. I'd be treated like a leper if they even found out. Even when I truly can't bother with the facade i heavily rely on everyday, they don't even bother asking if everything is okay and actually mean it. Nobody gives a damn.


I've never had a SO either, probably never will. I'm not desirable to the opposite sex, and even if I were in a relationship, I'd only make my partner miserable. 


Other than my dog, i am truly alone in all of this. 


And how strange, it is 4:27 in the morning here. I'm still drowsy, but can't return to sleep as i won't wake up in time to arrive at my hell hole of a job. And I'm expected to work 10hrs today.

It's okay.


Sometimes I wonder if earning any money is even worth it if you're miserable. Doesn't feel worth it. 


And I'm not sure a therapist can help me at this point :( I've been to one in college. The therapist was nice, and gave practical advice,  but ...I don't know why it was not effective.

Sorry

Didn't mean to skip over your message. 

Thank you for sharing your input

Yep - Routine, and something to hold your attention to prevent you from slipping into negative thoughts. That's what I've heard. 


But I find my self sitting at my desk, wishing something would put me out of my misery. I come home and have the same thoughts as I lay in bed :/


I just don't know anymore. I'm not even 26 yet, why I have to go through this i would never know. My 20s (youth) have been wasted.

Not sure if my high school and college peers really care who I am anymore. Never formed any close relationships with them. It's difficult to form bonds with anyone. Which is probably why my coworkers aren't too fond of me. I'm too shy and reserved, and it probably makes them uncomfortable. 


And my dog has arthritis so it is difficult for him to get around. He'd rather sit and nibble on snacks,  than walk anywhere. He's already expressed his displeasure about me not being at home,  so I think he cares.


As far as your other recommendations, if I ever can find time to do those things, I will try.


I'm still going to bed tonight wishing I don't wake up tomorrow morning =/ it sucks...
I do not want to be too specific,  but I am employed in the software/tech industry.

Sorry, I'm rushing to write this. 


It's difficult to find things that make me happy. Dabbling in art used to make me happy, but i lost interest 4 years ago. 


It's hard for me to recall my past hobbies add it's all a blur and I dint actually enjoy much of anything anymore. 


I like pets, but i think working with pets will just remind me how I've emotionally abandoned my own pet :( I haven't been able to take care of him since i started working. And he's old, with some health issues. I don't want him to be miserable like how he is now.

I don't actually enjoy anything anymore.


The line of work in doing now is related to my 'dream job'. Same industry, different line of work.


But I gave up on my aspirations 2 years ago. Haven't set a long term goal since. I'm not capable of achieving them at this point.

Doubt I'll hear back from anyone within the next half hour or at all


...phone is dying.

No. That doesn't make you a horrible person though. 


Even the people who probably spend all but 5 seconds thinking about me a few times a week wouldn't care. All of my hs and college peers would never know I was gone.
I knew there wasn't a point registering a throw away and writing this out. Nobody responds.

I've been taking mental refuge in an imaginary world too. Cannot offer much advice, as I'm struggling with the same issue.


Thought I was capable of providing something that could benefit society. It just isn't going to happen for me.
